local currentPage = 1
local buttonsPerPage = 12 -- 3 filas de 4 botones
local totalPages = math.ceil(#buttons / buttonsPerPage) -- 21/12 = 2 páginas

local function updatePage()
    -- Ocultar todos los botones
    for i, btn in ipairs(buttons) do
        btn.Visible = false
    end
    
    -- Mostrar solo los de la página actual
    local startIdx = (currentPage - 1) * buttonsPerPage + 1
    local endIdx = math.min(startIdx + buttonsPerPage - 1, #buttons)
    
    for i = startIdx, endIdx do
        local btn = buttons[i]
        btn.Visible = true
        local posInPage = i - startIdx
        local row = math.floor(posInPage / 4)
        local col = posInPage % 4
        btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15 + col * 100, 0, 10 + row * 55)
    end
    
    pageText.Text = "Página " .. currentPage .. "/" .. totalPages
end

pagePrev.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if currentPage > 1 then
        currentPage = currentPage - 1
        updatePage()
    end
end)

pageNext.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if currentPage < totalPages then
        currentPage = currentPage + 1
        updatePage()
    end
end)

-- Inicializar primera página

	local c = {warn=0,error=0,info=0,print=0}
	for _,l in ipairs(logs) do if c[l.t] then c[l.t]=c[l.t]+1 end end
	-- remap
	slbls.warn.Text  = tostring(c.warn)
	slbls.error.Text = tostring(c.error)
	slbls.info.Text  = tostring(c.info)
	slbls.print.Text = tostring(c.print)
end

_G._rbxconsole_rebuild = function()
	for _,c in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("Frame") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	order = 0
	local q = search:lower()
	local n = 0
	for i,l in ipairs(logs) do
		if filterOn[l.t] then
			if q=="" or l.m:lower():find(q,1,true) then
				buildRow(l,i); n=n+1
			end
		end
	end
	empty.Visible = (n==0); empty.Parent = list
	updateStats()
	task.defer(function() list.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0,math.huge) end)
end

	_G._rbxconsole_rebuild()
end
